description: This PHP class 'UpgraderCompleteController' manages the final step of an installation or upgrade process in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract controller to prepare a Vue.js component called 'upgrader-complete-screen,' sets it up with product version info, updates the state container to indicate completion, and logs the upgrade status.

classes.name: UpgraderCompleteController
classes.description: Controller handling the display and completion state of the upgrade process in the installer module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component 'upgrader-complete-screen' with version info, updates the state container to indicate upgrade completion, and logs the current upgrade status.
